name: fm-ci-pi-pin
description: Pinned Pi package set for the Pi extension tests. bin/fm-install-pi.sh owns the install from this manifest plus package-lock.json. Pi 1.2.0 provides the typed before_agent_start message variants used by the extensions. Pi itself and every @earendil-works/* transitive are pinned exactly to prevent incompatible sibling releases: pi-codemode 1.3.0 removed the MCP_TYPESCRIPT_PREAMBLE export used by earlier Pi versions.
